info.description:
Comprehensive end-to-end test collection for Gharsih plant recommendation backend.

Run in order: Auth(Admin) → Setup(Questions) → Setup(Plants) → Setup(Suitability) → Auth(User) → Recommendations → My Crops → Edge Cases.

All IDs are dynamically extracted and stored in collection variables.
All bodies with dynamic IDs are built in pre-request scripts to avoid invalid JSON.
